title: Sequin Chiffon Puff Sleeve Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this enchanting bridesmaid dress! Featuring delicate sequin embellishments, dreamy chiffon fabric, and romantic puff sleeves, this gown exudes timeless elegance. Perfect for celebrating love and creating unforgettable memories on your special day!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Puff sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
